designationHistory.indexText: Congress provided for Lincoln Boyhood National Memorial at the Tom Lincoln farm and Nancy Hanks Lincoln's grave in southern Indiana.
designationHistory.note: The act called for formal establishment by Federal Register notice once enough land was acquired; that notice was not located. Indiana ran the site as a state memorial before 1962 (NPS History Collection).

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (Indiana), 'Authorized Feb. 19, 1962'
